findings.title: Credential read from the request and never verified
findings.description: `password` is populated from the submitted `password` field in `login_post()` and is never compared, hashed or looked up. Authentication therefore succeeds for any password.
findings.exploit: Log in as any existing username with an arbitrary password. The instance grants `login_post()`'s full session.
findings.breaker: None. The checker authenticates with its real credentials, so this invisible to scoring and must be found by review.
findings.remediation: Verify the submitted credential against a stored hash.

findings.title: Password persisted without a hash
findings.description: `register_post()` writes a password column with no hashing call in scope. Anyone who reaches the datastore - directly, via SQLi or via traversal - reads every team's plaintext credentials.
findings.exploit: Reach the datastore, dump the table, log in as any team.
findings.breaker: None for the checker, which uses correct credentials. But combined with any read primitive this is a total compromise of the instance.
findings.remediation: Hash with bcrypt/argon2/scrypt and a per-user salt before storing.

findings.title: Session/cookie store key hardcoded
findings.description: A static signing key lets a team forge session cookies for arbitrary user ids, escalating privileges across the whole instance.
findings.exploit: Forge a session cookie carrying another user's id.
findings.breaker: None for the checker, which uses real credentials.
findings.remediation: Load the secret from the environment, rotate per deployment.

findings.title: Unscoped SELECT * returns credential-bearing rows
findings.description: A listing endpoint without scoping hands over the whole user table in one request.
findings.exploit: GET the listing and enumerate every team's data.
findings.breaker: Large result sets can time the instance out.
findings.remediation: Paginate and scope listings to the caller.

findings.title: Debug flag or verbose error surface enabled
findings.description: Stack traces and SQL fragments leak schema, paths and sometimes credentials.
findings.exploit: Send malformed input and read the error body.
findings.remediation: Disable debug output in deployed configuration.

findings.title: No rate limiting / lockout on an authentication endpoint
findings.description: Allows credential stuffing against the checker-generated accounts.
findings.exploit: Brute-force the checker's random username/password pair.
findings.breaker: Brute force can lock the instance out of its own account.
findings.remediation: Throttle per source address; do not permanently lock.
